title: Marketplace trial crediting and entitlement flows (draft)
content:
Purpose:

This working doc defines how Redwood will provision, meter, and communicate trial credits and entitlements for cloud marketplace listings (AWS/Azure/GCP and vendor-managed shelves). Aim is to: reduce friction for partners, make trial consumption predictable for finance, and minimize support incidents during trial onboarding.

Scope:
- Buyer-facing trial credit flows (self-serve tile activation, trial duration, credit amount)
- Partner entitlement mapping (SKU <> Redwood product SKU <> trial bucket)
- Billing/usage interplay (how credits apply to metered tokens, embeddings, dedicated usage)
- Marketplace tile/marketing copy variants for trial call-to-action
- Acceptance criteria and QA checklist for marketplace submission

Assumptions (what we expect from vendor/platform):
- Marketplace provides a trial entitlement token or start/end timestamps passed to our provisioning webhook.
- Marketplace metering reports usage daily to us and to billing systems (or we poll).
- Customers must have a Redwood account email to map trial to an account (SSO optional).
- Trial credits are refundable only within fraud-detection flags and partner SLA escalations.

High-level flow (textual):
1) Customer clicks tile -> selects "Activate trial" -> Marketplace requests provisioning webhook from Redwood with customer id, email, tenant id (if applicable).
2) Redwood creates a trial entitlement object: { type: 'marketplace-trial', partner: <vendor>, amount: <credits>, expires: <ts> } and attaches it to a new/existing Redwood user account.
3) Trial is visible in Console under Billing -> Credits (note: limited to 1 active marketplace trial per customer per product family).
4) Tokens consumed first draw down trial balance; once exhausted, usage falls back to paid billing path or blocked depending on SKU settings.
5) Redwood emits trial activation events to partner webhook and pushes telemetry to Marketplace (if required).

Entitlement matrix (recommended canonical mapping):
- Marketplace SKU: rwd-textgen-starter -> Redwood product SKU: text-generation; trial_credits: 100,000 tokens; duration: 14 days; auto_upgrade: false
- Marketplace SKU: rwd-embeddings-lite -> Redwood product SKU: embedding-basic; trial_credits: 50,000 embedding-units; duration: 7 days; auto_upgrade: true (opt-in)
- Marketplace SKU: rwd-dedicated-mini -> Redwood product SKU: dedicated-inference; trial_credits: 1 day reserved capacity; duration: 3 days (provisioned as trial capacity)

Business rules (must be enforced):
- Single-trial-per-org per product-family across marketplaces. Prevent chained trials via email or org alias detection.
- Trials expire at the end-of-day in the user's timezone of activation.
- Tokens consumed by function/tool-calls are billed against trial first, then paid path.
- If a customer upgrades to a paid plan mid-trial and cancels within 48h, retain pro-rated credits for 30 days (finance to sign-off).

Edge cases and fraud controls:
- Disposable emails: require secondary verification (phone or SSO) for trials above 200k tokens.
- Multi-marketplace conflict: if the same org activates different marketplace trials, the earliest activation wins; others are converted to a 25% promotional credit and flagged for partner ops review.
- Abuse detection flow: rate-limit per-tenant and throttle suspicious provisioning. Auto-revoke trial if > 10M tokens in 24h.

Marketplace tile copy variants (short)
- Hero: "Try Redwood Inference free — 100k tokens, 14 days"
- Sub: "Evaluate latency-optimized text generation and embeddings in your cloud account. No card required."
- CTA: "Activate free trial"

Marketplace tile copy variants (longer / description)
- Variant A (developer-focused): "Run high-throughput LLM inference with predictable latency. Activate a 14-day trial with 100k tokens to test throughput, streaming, and SDK integrations. Works with existing billing in your cloud console."
- Variant B (platform-focused): "Reserved capacity trials available for dedicated deployment evaluation — provision a 3-day reserved slot and validate end-to-end throughput with your model workloads."
- Variant C (security-focused): "Private deployments and VPC-ready options. Trial includes sample private endpoint and audit logs for compliance testing."

Marketplace listing metadata checklist (pre-submission):
- [ ] Product summary (<=150 chars) matches hero copy
- [ ] Full description includes clear trial terms (credits, duration, limitations)
- [ ] Trial activation instructions: one-click activation path documented
- [ ] Marketplace webhook endpoints tested in staging with live payloads
- [ ] Entitlement mapping table included in vendor submission package
- [ ] Sample tile screenshot + console snapshot for QA
- [ ] Legal: trial T&Cs included (link to Redwood T&C and privacy notice)
- [ ] Security: minimal permissions required by marketplace to provision trial (list scopes)

Acceptance criteria for QA (internal):
- Provisioning webhook accepted and returns 200 within 2s for 95% of requests (test harness result).
- Trial credit object visible in Console within 20s of marketplace activation event.
- Token consumption decreases trial balance in near-real-time (<= 1 min delay in UI).
- Edge case: trial auto-expires and blocks write requests by the stated expiry time.
- Billing path: usage post-trial appears as chargeable usage under the same account and generates invoice preview.

Telemetry and observability requirements:
- Trial activation events must include partner id, marketplace id, tenant id, activation_ts, and activation_origin (tile/ui/webhook).
- Dashboards: active trials count by partner, average consumption per trial, trials flagged for abuse.
- Alerts: spike in trial activations (> 3x baseline in 1h) -> automatic pager to GTM ops.

Implementation notes for engineering handoff:
- API: POST /marketplace/provision -> body: {marketplace, partner_sku, customer_email, marketplace_txn_id, requested_credits, expires_at} -> returns entitlement_id
- Idempotency: provision requests must be idempotent by marketplace_txn_id (return same entitlement if replayed).
- Security: marketplace webhook must be signed; verify signature header + timestamp within 5 minutes.
- Data model: entitlement record must include partner_reference (string), entitlement_kind (string), credits_total (int), credits_remaining (int), expires_at (ISO8601), linked_account_id (uuid)

Open questions / TODOs (to be resolved before submission):
- Finance: confirm whether trial credits should be recorded as deferred revenue adjustments or as marketing expense (ask FP&A).
- Legal: add explicit clause for data retention and telemetry sharing with marketplace partners — is partner-system telemetry allowed?
- Partner ops: define SLA for partner-facing support on trial provisioning issues (SLA window and escalation path).
- UX: what experience do we show if customer tries to re-activate the same trial from a different marketplace (need copy for conflict resolution)?

Suggested next steps and owners:
- Aisha: finalize entitlement mapping and sample webhook payloads (due 2025-10-06)
- Miguel: wireframe trial page UI and error states (due 2025-10-09)
- Priya: run security review on webhook signing and scopes (due 2025-10-03)
- Samir: confirm finance treatment with FP&A and write billing note (due 2025-10-10)

Appendix: sample webhook payloads (FAQ-style):
- Activation payload (example): {
  "marketplace": "aws",
  "marketplace_txn_id": "aws-TXN-20250918-001",
  "customer_email": "dev@acme.co",
  "partner_sku": "rwd-textgen-starter",
  "requested_credits": 100000,
  "expires_at": "2025-10-02T23:59:59Z"
}

- Revoke payload (example): {
  "marketplace": "gcp",
  "marketplace_txn_id": "gcp-TXN-20250928-070",
  "entitlement_id": "ent-8c9f2",
  "reason": "fraud-suspected"
}

Notes to reviewers: this doc is an operational-first draft — expect rough language and TODOs. Please add comments inline or ping in #gtm-marketplace for synchronous review.
